To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
RDF2Vec is a powerful and flexible approach to generate features from RDF graphs that can be used for a variety of different machine learning tasks.

(i) we present an approach to learn vector representations for RDF graphs, (ii) we show that such vector representations can be used to improve predictive data mining tasks, and (iii) such vector representations can easily be reused for different tasks and datasets.

1) RDF2Vec is a generic and flexible method for learning feature representations of RDF graphs; 2) RDF2Vec features are competitive with the state-of-the-art in a number of data mining tasks, and can be reused in multiple settings; 3) RDF2Vec can be used to learn representations of entities in knowledge graphs; 4) RDF2Vec representations of entities in Wikidata and DBpedia are competitive with state-of-the-art methods in a number of tasks;
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: (1) Can RDF graph embeddings be used as features for machine learning tasks? (2) How can RDF2Vec be used to learn graph embeddings for RDF graphs and other knowledge graphs? (3) How can the resulting graph embeddings be used for different machine learning tasks?
the question of how to generate propositional representations from RDF graphs, and how to reuse such representations for different tasks.
the development of a general approach to learn latent representations of RDF graphs, which are suitable for a variety of data mining tasks, and which can be reused across different tasks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our approach outperforms all other state-of-the-art techniques in all the considered scenarios.
RDF2Vec is a promising approach to learn vector representations of RDF graphs that can be used in a variety of different data mining tasks.
our approach is a very good candidate for the propositionalisation of RDF graphs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown the feasibility of using graph embeddings for data mining on knowledge graphs, and that such representations can be used to improve data mining tasks.
RDF2Vec provides a simple yet effective approach to learn latent representations from RDF graphs.
RDF2Vec is an effective and efficient approach for the propositionalisation of RDF graphs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
graph embeddings can be used to generate features from knowledge graphs for data mining tasks, and that such features are competitive with the best existing propositionalization techniques.
the use of graph embeddings is a promising approach for the integration of Linked Data in data mining tasks.
the use of language modeling techniques for the proposionalization of RDF graphs is a viable approach, and opens up new avenues for the use of Linked Data as background information for data mining.
